findings.title: No JSON-LD structured data was observed on crawled pages
findings.evidence: No parseable JSON-LD was observed on 1 crawled HTML page(s). This is a coverage statement about the crawled set, not a claim about unfetched URLs. Metrics: pages_checked=1; jsonld_pages=0; site_type=ecommerce. Observed on: http://127.0.0.1:8877/.

suggested_action.summary: Add JSON-LD that matches this site's apparent type (ecommerce), starting with Organization, WebSite, Product.
suggested_action.details: Infer type from the site's own content. Do not add Product schema to a campus site.

findings.mechanism: Without explicit schema.org objects, machines must guess entities from prose.
findings.impact: The site is harder to cite as a typed Organization, Product, or Article.

findings.title: Important pages return non-2xx HTTP status
findings.evidence: 2 important page(s) returned non-2xx status among 3 attempts. Metrics: status_codes=(http://127.0.0.1:8877/about: 404, http://127.0.0.1:8877/products/jacket: 404). Observed on: http://127.0.0.1:8877/about, http://127.0.0.1:8877/products/jacket.

suggested_action.summary: Restore 2xx responses for public important URLs or 301 them to live replacements.

findings.mechanism: Crawlers drop or distrust URLs that do not return a successful status.
findings.impact: Those URLs cannot be reliably indexed or cited.

findings.title: Broken internal links were observed during the crawl
findings.evidence: 2 internal URL(s) linked from crawled pages returned 404/410. Metrics: broken_urls=http://127.0.0.1:8877/products/jacket, http://127.0.0.1:8877/about; pages_checked=3; merged_EG-005=(broken_urls: http://127.0.0.1:8877/about, http://127.0.0.1:8877/products/jacket). Observed on: http://127.0.0.1:8877/products/jacket, http://127.0.0.1:8877/about. Also observed via EG-005: Visitors are sent to broken internal URLs

suggested_action.summary: Fix or redirect the broken internal targets and remove stale hrefs.

findings.mechanism: Dead internal links waste crawl budget and strand visitors.
findings.impact: Both humans and machines fail to reach the promised page.

findings.title: No Open Graph title/description metadata was observed
findings.evidence: 0/1 crawled page(s) exposed og:* meta tags. Metrics: pages_checked=1. Observed on: http://127.0.0.1:8877/.

suggested_action.summary: Add og:title, og:description, and og:url on the homepage and key templates.

findings.mechanism: og:title and og:description are a widely consumed fallback when JSON-LD is absent.
findings.impact: Link unfurls and some crawlers get a weaker title/description pair.

findings.title: Homepage never states who the offering is for
findings.evidence: No 'for <audience>' / 'built for' phrasing was observed on the homepage. Metrics: site_type=ecommerce; h1=Outdoor apparel for weekend hikers. Observed on: http://127.0.0.1:8877/.

suggested_action.summary: Add one clause naming the intended customer or visitor on the homepage.

findings.mechanism: Without an audience phrase, visitors cannot self-qualify and assistants omit the 'for whom' clause.
findings.impact: Weaker engagement and weaker citations in 'best X for Y' questions.

proactive_recommendations.summary: Introduce Product markup on the product template
proactive_recommendations.why_it_matters: The crawl already found product-like URLs; typed offers would make them citable.
proactive_recommendations.what_to_change: Add Product JSON-LD that repeats the visible name and price.
proactive_recommendations.expected_benefit: Higher chance of being selected as a source for product questions.

proactive_recommendations.summary: Keep commercially important strings in the initial HTML even if the UI is a JS app
proactive_recommendations.why_it_matters: This audit could not fully rely on a browser; many assistants are in the same position.
proactive_recommendations.what_to_change: Prerender title, primary description, and prices, or duplicate them in JSON-LD.
proactive_recommendations.expected_benefit: Discoverability no longer depends on a headless browser.

limitations: Browser rendering was skipped; raw-vs-rendered gaps may be under-counted.
Crawl budget stopped at 1 of 3 discovered URLs.
